title: Should schools require community service?
assignment: Write an argumentative essay taking a position on whether high schools should require community service.
text: High schools should require a modest amount of community service because students learn civic responsibility by contributing to real communities. A requirement should be flexible enough to include tutoring, environmental work, or service through an approved organization. Critics argue that required service is not truly voluntary, but schools can address this concern by allowing students to choose the cause and by explaining the educational purpose. Community service should not replace academic support or employment, yet a limited requirement can connect classroom discussions about citizenship to practical action.
